headline: India’s telecom regulator opens consultation on responsible AI-use guidelines
summary: On 30 October 2026, India’s Telecom Regulatory Authority (TRAI) opened a consultation on draft AI guidance for authorised entities using AI in telecom networks or services; comments are due 27 November. The 12-page proposal would require board-approved internal policies, system risk classification and inventory, pre-deployment assessments, incident and user-harm recording, senior governance oversight, and reporting of high- and critical-severity incidents. It is a consultation draft, not a final rule. Adoption, provider implementation, costs and operational effects remain unestablished.
